name: Sting
description: Sting is a software-led transaction rail for Southern Africa's unbanked consumers, built around Sting Wallet, a closed-loop payment system. It enters the market through social group purchasing for on-demand alcohol delivery — customers order from their phone and an independent delivery runner brings the order to their door, the way you would use Uber Eats or Mr D Food, but built specifically around alcohol, drinks, and a wallet you can share with friends.

founder.jobTitle: Co-Founder and Chief Product & Technology Officer

platform_identity.core_offering: A closed-loop payment system (Sting Wallet) paired with on-demand delivery of alcohol, cold drinks, mixers, and ice from partner stores, ordered and paid for from the Sting app.
platform_identity.process: Sign up → confirm age (18+) → optional ID verification (skippable) → top up Sting Wallet by card or EFT → browse partner stores → build a cart (alone or shared with friends) → pay from Sting Wallet or by card → independent runner delivers, checking identification in person.
platform_identity.closed_loop_wallet: Sting Wallet balances can only be loaded in and spent on Sting orders — paying for one's own order or contributing toward a shared order. There is no cash-out, withdrawal, or general-purpose money transfer out of Sting.
platform_identity.differentiator: Unlike general food-delivery apps (Uber Eats, Mr D Food), Sting is purpose-built around alcohol and a shared wallet: age/identity verification is core to the ordering flow, and customers can pool a wallet balance in a shared cart to split one order between a group.

related_platform.name: Sting Runner
related_platform.relationship: Sting Runner is the separate application and onboarding process for people who deliver Sting orders. It shares Sting's underlying account system but has its own content, terms, and audience — not described by this document.
